shortBio.en: Soundgarden drummer; Pearl Jam drummer from 1998 — Seattle’s longest shared-kit bridge.
shortBio.zh: Soundgarden 鼓手；1998 起 Pearl Jam 鼓手——西雅图最长共用鼓位桥。

whyHub.en: Soundgarden ↔ Pearl Jam personnel edge; odd-meter hard-rock kit craft across two catalog bands.
whyHub.zh: Soundgarden ↔ Pearl Jam 人事边；两支编年史乐队上的奇数拍 hard-rock 鼓工。

body.en:
Born 1962. Drums Soundgarden through Badmotorfinger / Superunknown eras and reunions. Joins Pearl Jam 1998 after Jack Irons; stays through Yield-forward touring and studio cycles.

Related: Seattle drumming as transferable infrastructure between two complete pages.
body.zh:
1962 年生。鼓 Soundgarden 至 Badmotorfinger / Superunknown 与重聚。1998 接 Jack Irons 进 Pearl Jam；Yield 之后巡演与录音周期仍在。

相关：西雅图鼓作为两篇完整页之间可迁移的基础设施。
